description: This file contains a PHP class for managing the dashboard order extension in the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for displaying the order dashboard, saving settings, and generating order info data.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for the dashboard order extension, extends the base Controller class and provides methods for displaying, saving, and retrieving order dashboard data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the order dashboard page in the admin panel, setting up breadcrumbs, loading models, and rendering the order form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the dashboard order extension settings via AJAX, returning a JSON response indicating success or failure.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Generates and returns data for the order dashboard, including total orders today and yesterday, percentage change, and total sales amount, formatted for display.
